_help: Describes this model. stl is relative to this folder. mountOffsetMm / mountRotationDeg say where the STL's origin sits in the PLATE frame (origin = centre of the plate top, X right, Y far edge, Z up), so they are zero when the model is centred on the plate and its STL origin is the centre of its base.
name: PMB-1A
notes: 3D-printed practice piece with an irregular surface. Z up, origin at the centre of its base.
